Topology NETWORK (⚖️ founder 2026-09-10, HW.33); gyroid_wall_param is TOPOLOGY-COUPLED — 0.10 hits the 65% target on network, the sheet-era 1.0 would land ~50% (i.e. STIFFER than sheet). name: anchor_zone1_mangrove

notes.material: V-free Ti alloy (01_02 2.5, founder 2026-06-21) - the SPECIFIC alloy is NOT selected until the Stage-2 coin bake-off (00_07 HW.24); Ti-6Al-4V is the price and print baseline only, NOT the material of this part
notes.process: SLM/LPBF MANDATORY for Zone 1 - NOT EBM, and the powder fraction is the reason: 15-45 um resolves the lattice where EBM 45-105 um risks plugging fine pores (01_02 1.7) | HIP obligatory 920C/100-150 MPa Ar/2-4 h, then vacuum anneal 800C/2 h (01_02 1.3 Step 2, 1.7) | build direction PARALLEL to the long axis, 0 +/-5 deg, externally-only supports (01_02 1.6) | de-powdering is CHEMICAL: vacuum decanting + citric/Tween circulation (1.3 Step 3). NO Al2O3 sand-blasting and NO static-tank etching on this part - both are canon-forbidden for Zone 1 specifically, unlike the Zone-3 flange (01_02 1.3a Failure Modes A and B)
notes.post_process: EAAE with forced flow-through + ultrasonic cavitation (01_02 1.3 Step 4), then dehydrogenation bake 250C/10-3 mbar/3h within 2h of rinse - MANDATORY, and HIP does NOT substitute for it: hydrogen enters AFTER HIP, at the EAAE stage (01_02 1.3a Failure Mode C). LECO RH404 H<100 ppm per batch or the batch is rejected
notes.surface_finish: EAAE dual-scale on the gyroid walls: micro Sa 0.5-5 um + nano Sv 50-500 nm, BET area >10x a smooth sample (01_02 1.2). NO PEP smoothing on this part - the plasma sheath is Faraday-caged in sub-500 um channels and PEP belongs to the Zone-3 outer jacket only (01_02 1.3 Step 7)
notes.coating_restriction: Gyroid walls in xylem-sap contact (the anode active surface): ZnO-Ta, self-healing 8-HQ and biomimetic (Zn-HAp/chitosan) ALL FORBIDDEN - any dielectric blocks DET, and canon forbids ZnO-Ta on Zone-1 gyroid walls outright (01_02 3.6). Bare Ti with the dual-scale roughness only; the Gen 2.0 bio-electrochemical stack is applied by us downstream, cold (01_03 2.1). The Zone-1 PERIPHERY in callus contact, carrying no immobilised enzymes, is a DIFFERENT row of the same map (Zn-HAp + chitosan allowed, ZnO-Ta only outside the enzyme zone - 01_02 3.6, 01_04 4). WHERE that boundary runs is STILL not a field of this manifest and is not derivable from the geometry. Since 2026-09-11 it has a CARRIER but not an ANSWER: draw anchor_zone1 renders the refusal on the sheet itself - a leader pointing at the rim plus its own NOTES line - so the shop is handed the question instead of a silent default. Query it before applying anything; do not infer it from the geometry (00_07 HW.1)
notes.lattice_spec: Gyroid, NETWORK topology (ratified founder 2026-09-10, 00_07 HW.33) - ONE through pore labyrinth by construction. Cell period is graded core->rim by this manifest's own fields; read them, not prose. Porosity (ratified 2026-09-17, 01_01 5.2): nominal 65%, and the factory is judged by the 60-70% band (01_02 1.2) on the WHOLE part - on a graded part the shells are reported, not judged. There is NO 65 +/-2% acceptance number: canon gives it no home (01_01 5.5), so reject against the band only. Verify by Archimedes open porosity + uCT connectivity (01_02 1.2)
notes.inspection: SEM before shipment at x500 (gyroid macro-pores), x5,000 (micro-roughness: report the AREAL Sa of the 01_02 1.2 acceptance row, not a profile Ra) and x50,000 (nano-pores Sv) - all three frames apply to THIS part because it has the macro-pore geometry the x500 frame is for; if nano-pores are not visible at x50,000 the etch is insufficient and EAAE is repeated (01_02 1.5). ATTENTION: the batch-level SEM ACCEPTANCE CRITERION - what morphology passes, as opposed to which frames to shoot - does not exist in canon yet and is an open leg (00_07 HW.1); do not read its absence as a pass. uCT - FIRST ARTICLE and every PROCESS CHANGE, not every batch (ratified 2026-09-21, 00_07 HW.1): batch porosity is accepted by the 60-70% band on the whole part with an Archimedes cross-check (01_02 1.2), and the pore-size profile below is REPORTED, not judged - so a per-batch uCT would buy a report that rejects nothing. If you change the process (machine, powder lot, parameter set, support strategy, heat-treatment route), say so: that is what re-triggers the scan. uCT pore-gradient verification in the PRINTED range: the pore-size profile has NO acceptance target anywhere - it is REPORTED, not judged (01_01 5.5); porosity is judged by the 60-70% band on the WHOLE part (01_02 1.2). The uCT order must NAME its processing, because a pore size is an output of the algorithm chosen: report local thickness by maximal inscribed sphere for BOTH phases (pore and metal ligament) - the measure our design instruments use (01_01 5.5), so the two compare - and mean chord length separately, labelled, never merged into one 'pore size'. Report (1) global porosity, cross-checked against Archimedes; (2) the radial profile of both thickness distributions, in shells outward from the part axis; (3) topological integrity - disconnected metal islands, wall breaks, closed pores; plus the scan voxel size and the segmentation-threshold method. Archimedes open porosity. LECO RH404 H<100 ppm per batch or rejected. ICP-MS of the rinse water, Al<1 ppb - confirms no corundum residue (01_02 1.2, 1.5)
extra: Zone 1 = the buried anode: gyroid walls in xylem sap (01_01 1)

The bus wire (01_01 1.4) is NOT printed with this part: it is a cold-drawn wire of the same alloy, welded to the anode's top face (01_01 3 step 1b). This part is printed WITHOUT a core - the gyroid lattice runs to the axis - and bus_rod_diameter_mm declares the WIRE diameter, an assembly dimension, not a feature to print. The porosity and connectivity gates therefore measure the whole lattice cross-section

slm_min_wall_mm is a VENDOR input (ratified 2026-09-10): absent means the canon 200 um default of 01_01 5.5 (a DEFAULT, not a constant - and a different quantity from the 0.3 mm gyroid wall floor of 01_02 1.7), and the same number also sets the measurement grid - a finer vendor floor costs about an order of magnitude more run time

The factory sheet EXISTS since 2026-09-11 (draw anchor_zone1 -> SVG + DXF, 00_07 HW.1): these notes are both the SOURCE of the acceptance contract and, through that generator, its CARRIER. Re-run draw after editing any note - nothing re-runs the published gallery for you

The envelope O is NOT a press-fit surface: canon puts the Zone1<->Zone2 contact band on the SOLID shank (01_01 4.2, cem/mechanical_lock.zone1.json), not on this lattice, so the Lame interference window of 01_01 4.2 sets the shank's band, not this one. That holds only while Zone 1 enters the sleeve no deeper than the shank - the insertion depth is itself open (00_07 HW.26 G1), and a deeper one would put this lattice into the bore and reopen the question. The diametral band of the envelope is therefore BLANK rather than absent: canon does not specify it, so quote your achievable as-printed band rather than reading a default into the blank

The bus wire's root (its axis at the weld on the top face) must line up with the cathode channel: its offset from this part's outer-diameter axis is a REQUIRED datum of the anchor stack, and its tolerance is NOT SPECIFIED until the insertion depth is decided (00_07 HW.26 G1, HW.34)
